text:
tara: FYI onboarding for customer 'northbridge' is flaky. SCIM create returns 409 for some users and audit shows missing user.create rows for the same window 2026-04-02T11:20Z. Also seeing KMS decrypt failures in the audit producer. anyone?

odie: paste the provisioning + audit-producer logs pls. short snippets are fine.

tara: log excerpts:
```
2026-04-02T11:19:58Z INFO scim-provisioner: start create externalId=north-ops-227
2026-04-02T11:20:00Z ERROR audit-producer.kms: decrypt failed: InvalidEncryptionContext
2026-04-02T11:20:00Z ERROR audit-producer: failed to publish user.create, moving to DLQ
2026-04-02T11:20:01Z ERROR scim-client: HTTP 409 Conflict {"detail":"User with email already exists"}
```

ryan: InvalidEncryptionContext often means the envelope was encrypted with a different context than the one used for decrypt. Did we change the encryption context key derivation or include tenant id differently?

odie: Also 409 says IdP thinks the email already exists. Could be normalization differences (case, unicode normalization, trailing dot). We recently rolled out stricter canonicalization for emails in the provisioning service. Any recent deploys around 11:15-11:18?

tara: yes we deployed a small normalization fix at 11:14 that lowercases and NFC-normalizes emails. Prior data might be NFD. The audit-producer encrypts payload with context {"tenant":"northbridge","env":"prod"}. Not sure what changed.

ryan: check the audit-producer artifact version. If it started including a new metadata field (e.g., request_id) in the encryption context, older decryptors would fail. Run `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob --encryption-context Key1=Val1` as a smoke test using the audit-indexer role. Also list-grants for the CMK to ensure the indexer can Decrypt.

odie: good call. I see the audit-producer image tag bumped in that deploy: audit-producer:v2.3.0 -> v2.4.0 which added `context.requester` to the encryption context. The indexer still expects the older context shape. That would cause InvalidEncryptionContext and DLQing.

tara: so timeline: deploy changed encryption context, indexer fails to decrypt and drops audit rows, meanwhile the scim-provisioner changed email canonicalization which caused the IdP to report the email already exists (different canonicalization path) and our flow aborted before emitting any compensating audit. That explains both missing audit rows and 409s.

ryan: immediate remediations: 1) roll back the producer to v2.3.0 temporarily or 2) update indexer to accept the new context keys (preferred). For a quick fix, we can patch indexer to accept both context shapes and replay DLQ.

odie: also check KMS grants/permissions after recent RBAC changes. We had a policy tweak last week that tightened the indexer role trust. Ensure the indexer role can call kms:Decrypt on the CMK alias `alias/redwood/audit`.

tara: ran sts get-caller-identity from indexer pod and `aws kms decrypt` smoke test: decrypt still works for a small test blob with no context, but with the v2.4.0 context it fails. list-grants shows grants ok for role. so not IAM denial—just context mismatch.

ryan: OK. Patch plan: deploy indexer v1.8.1 that accepts both contexts (backcompat) and start DLQ replay. Also revert producer if patching takes >30m. Add a feature flag to the producer to toggle extra context keys so future rollouts can be gradual.

tara: started indexer patch rollout to one-zone canary.

nimbus-bot: canary indexer v1.8.1 started (canary-id idx-canary-20260402-01). health OK.

odie: while canary rolls, we should handle the email canonicalization mismatch for already-created users. Write a reconciliation job: normalize existing IdP emails into new canonical form and mark canonical_email on our internal user table, then dedupe. Also notify customer that their IdP may have users with emails that canonicalize differently (unicode/NFC).

ryan: add to that job: when creating a canonical_email mapping, check for collisions and prefer the IdP record with verified=true or latest last_login. Emit an admin audit and create a merge ticket.

tara: DLQ replay job queued for the 11:18-11:22 window specifically for northbridge.

auditor-bot: DLQ replay started (job dlq-replay-20260402-01) targeting audit.topic for tenant northbridge.

odie: also escalate an RBAC note: last week we applied a lockdown that removed `kms:DescribeKey` from the indexer role; that made troubleshooting harder (couldn't inspect key policy). Update runbook to require DescribeKey for indexer on troubleshoot path.

ryan: agreed. For the postmortem: root cause = producer changed encryption context shape without coordinated indexer update; contributing = recent email canonicalization change in provisioner exposing duplicates at the IdP; operational gap = RBAC change removed DescribeKey and slowed triage. Remediations: backcompat patch to indexer (deployed), feature-flag for producer context, DLQ replay done, reconciliation job to canonicalize emails, add DescribeKey to troubleshooting role, update pre-deploy checklist to include KMS context compatibility check.

tara: canary passed; rolling full indexer patch. auditor-bot: DLQ replay complete, 18 audit rows restored for northbridge, provisioning retries show 201 for previously-409 users.

odie: I'll open the PR for the reconciliation job and the runbook updates. Also add a monitoring rule to alert when audit-producer encryption-context keys change on deploy (compare config hash).

tara: thanks all. closing once PRs merged. :white_check_mark:
